title: thelypteris normalis var. harperi
intro: Thelypteris normalis var. harperi, commonly known as the Harper's fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is a plant native to North America, used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Harper's fern include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe wounds and reduce inflammation. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
